info.name: SPARK-272 Parking Search
info.description: Run requests individually against a configured development stack. Fixture-specific cases need deliberate local setup described in the guide.

request.description: Known positive or zero requires fresh complete evidence.
Use a future requested stay of at most 24 hours.
All returned sites satisfy radius and lot type.
Every returned site has a fresh count above zero.
A returned item has an interval estimate in range.
Copy data.nextCursor into the environment when nonnull.
Use the same coordinates and filters as request 06.
Fixture needs a published site with complete evidence and zero available slots.
Fixture needs a currently published closure. Expect known zero and closed reason.
Fixture needs incomplete or indeterminate candidate evidence. Expect null count and unknown state.
Expect catalogue and applicable tariff, with null pooled availability.
Fixture needs active CAR quota below free named slots.
Fixture needs maintenance beginning exactly at endAt and an Operations buffer. Compare with SPARK-273 admission.
Expect VALIDATION_FAILED and no owner dispatch.
Controlled fixture must change publication after catalogue read; expect SEARCH_CHANGED.
Controlled owner outage or malformed evidence; expect sanitized DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE.
Set keyword to a real published site-name fragment within the chosen radius.
Fixture: published facility name containing Bến Đỗ in radius; compare with request 19.
Same fixture as request 18; compare returned site IDs.
No fixture; trimmed keyword exceeds 100 characters.
Fixture: at least two published sites with distinct fresh hourly tariffs; include genuine zero and unknown/stale cases when available.
Fixture: future stay and distinct fresh total estimates; compare totals, not hourly tariffs.
Fixture: sites with distinct fresh CAR counts, a known zero, and unknown/stale evidence.
Needs at least two matching published sites; stores priceCursor when provided.
Repeat exact filters from request 24; requires its nonempty priceCursor.
Needs at least two matching sites; stores availabilityCursor when provided.
Repeat exact filters from request 26; requires its nonempty availabilityCursor.
Run request 24 first, then reuse its price cursor with changed sort.
Driver bearer token. Fixture: latest qualifying reservation at a currently published usable site.
No token; expect authentication challenge.
Use a valid token for a non-Driver role; no fixture reservation needed.
Driver with qualifying booking; induce Facility dependency failure in isolated development stack.
Public. Repeat for the four configured local API URLs. A 200 confirms reachability.

Manual only. Use a seeded Driver, Owner or Operator email and a local secret password. Copy data.accessToken to the appropriate local role variable after completed authentication. Complete any challenge through the existing application.

exec: const body = { email: pm.variables.get('fixtureEmail'), password: pm.variables.get('fixturePassword') };
pm.test('Session or MFA challenge', () => {const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); if (!body.mfaRequired) pm.expect(body.data.accessToken).to.be.a('string'); });

request.description: Use the selected Driver token. Primary Drivers have three fixture CARs and Driver 06 has one.

exec: pm.test('Response contract', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.data).to.be.an('array'); });

request.description: Public. Copy coordinates, radius and the expected ordered site codes from the manual guide. MVPSEED limits the test to this dataset.

exec: pm.test('Response contract', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); const codes = ['01','02','03','04','05']; const sites = Object.fromEntries(codes.map(n => [pm.variables.get(`mvp${n}SiteId`), n])); pm.expect(body.data.items.map(item => sites[item.siteId])).to.eql(pm.variables.get('expectedMvpSites').split(',')); });

request.description: Public. Use the comparison origin and actual installed T+5h through T+6h. Compare counts to the offline table when the live schedule aligns with T.

exec: pm.test('Response contract', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.data.items).to.have.lengthOf(5); body.data.items.forEach(item => pm.expect(item.availability.kind).to.eql('interval')); });

request.description: Driver. Uses creation-time ordering. For continuation use 39 with the last row's createdAt and reservationId.

exec: pm.test('Response contract', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.data).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(body.data.length).to.be.at.most(10); });

request.description: Same Driver as 38. Both values come from the final item of 38. Clear them before switching accounts.

exec: pm.test('Response contract', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.data).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(body.data.map(x => x.reservationId)).not.to.include(pm.variables.get('historyBeforeId')); });

request.description: Use owning Driver. Defaults to Driver 01's zero reservation. Switch fixture and role together for replacement, mismatch, overstay or pending.
Driver. Use Driver 05 for the mismatch. The response describes the Account-attributed session, not the unlocated walk-in.
Assigned Operator. Repeat per site. Compare linked and walk-in rows and the null location of the unlocated MVP-04 walk-in.

exec: pm.test('Response contract', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.data).to.be.an('array'); });

request.description: Assigned Operator. Use MVP-05 to compare the occupied scanned bay and the expected allocation. Read only.

item.name: MVP · Local financial reads and monthly coverage

request.description: Public. Verify the applicable monthly fixture price and availability-only terms.
Assigned Operator. Repeat with the covered pair or a wrong plate or wrong site with a correctly scoped Operator. Uses the real clock and the entitlement interval.

exec: pm.test('Response contract', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); const covered = pm.variables.get('expectedCovered') === 'true'; pm.expect(body.data.isCovered).to.eql(covered); pm.expect(body.data.amountDueVnd).to.eql(covered ? 0 : null); });

request.description: Owning Driver. Local lookup only. Zero and positive settled orders are PAID. The pending order is PAYABLE until deadline then CLOSED.
Use the owning Driver for the zero reservation or assigned MVP-01 Operator for the CASH walk-in. For the Operator variant, select its local token in this request.
Driver or customer with the supported Payment role. Driver 01 should see the zero receipt and monthly purchase invoice when using the seeded Account.

exec: pm.test('Response contract', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.items).to.be.an('array'); });

request.description: Owning Owner with lot-management permission. Default MVP-01 synthetic monthly collections are 600000 VND.

exec: pm.test('Response contract', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.data).to.be.an('object'); });
